canonicalization: SHA256 of canonical_protocol serialized as UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators

membership.preferred: official index-provider point-in-time NIFTY 100 constituent record
membership.fallback: official NSE archival constituent record, then a broker-primary dated constituent snapshot only if provenance and effective date are explicit
membership.semantics: membership effective at selection-date close using only information published by then

identity.preferred: official NSE security/instrument master effective at selection date
identity.fallback: broker-primary instrument master reconciled to official NSE security master
identity.semantics: identity valid at each requested session
identity.failure: exclude unresolved candidate; block if cohort below 20

liquidity.preferred: official NSE daily security-wise turnover/traded-value field
liquidity.fallback: broker-primary daily OHLCV, with traded value approximated as daily VWAP times volume if VWAP exists, otherwise sum of canonical five-minute typical-price times volume; one method frozen for all candidates
fields: official traded value or required price-volume fields
liquidity.semantics: 60 valid sessions strictly before selection date

calendar.preferred: official NSE trading holiday, circular, and special-session records
calendar.fallback: broker-primary session calendar only when reconciled to an official circular reference
calendar.semantics: calendar facts effective for each date

corporate_actions.preferred: official NSE corporate-action and security-change records
corporate_actions.fallback: issuer filing or official depository record; broker-primary only as corroboration
corporate_actions.semantics: apply only actions effective by the relevant session

context.preferred: official NSE/index-provider identity and constituent methodology records
context.fallback: broker-primary index master reconciled to official identity
context.semantics: NIFTY 50 and sector identity fixed at selection date

selection_date.rule: last authoritative valid trading session strictly preceding Stage A start
selection_date.knowledge_cutoff: all membership, identity, sector, listing, and eligibility facts must have publication/effective timestamps no later than selection-date close

liquidity.definition: median of exactly 60 daily traded-value observations on the 60 authoritative valid normal sessions strictly before selection date
liquidity.preferred_field: official daily turnover/traded value for the permitted series
liquidity.fallback_formula: daily VWAP*volume if authoritative VWAP is present; otherwise sum over canonical 5-minute bars of typical price ((H+L+C)/3)*volume
liquidity.missing: any missing required observation makes candidate ineligible; minimum and required observations both 60
liquidity.special_sessions: excluded from the 60-session window; walk backward to obtain 60 normal sessions
liquidity.actions: use official traded value without price adjustment; fallback price-volume inputs use continuity factors consistently and record method
liquidity.ranking: descending median traded value, then ascending ISIN, then ascending normalized symbol

eligibility.history: listed and continuously identifiable for at least 252 authoritative normal sessions before Stage A start
eligibility.availability: all 60 liquidity observations plus capability to request full A/B/C raw interval
eligibility.identity: unambiguous permanent identity, ISIN, symbol/series, and token mapping

sector_cap.rationale: four of 24 caps nominal sector weight at one-sixth while permitting diversified completion
sector_cap.algorithm: iterate liquidity rank; accept only if sector accepted count remains <=4; skipped names are never reconsidered discretionarily
sector_cap.shortfall: continue down ranking; accept 20-23 if 24 impossible; below 20 blocks research

selection_algorithm: sort descending with ISIN then symbol tie-breaks

survivorship.rule: retain selected permanent identity through all valid subsequent history; never replace retrospectively
survivorship.unavailable_representation: calendar rows remain in manifest with availability status EVENT_UNAVAILABLE, reason, effective timestamp, and no fabricated OHLC or zero return

corporate_actions.identity_vs_price: identity links are separate from price adjustment factors
corporate_actions.raw: preserve execution-valid unadjusted OHLCV and immutable raw hashes
corporate_actions.reference: maintain separate dated adjustment-factor/reference series for analytical continuity

actions.split_bonus: record ratio and factor; never rewrite raw
actions.rights_distribution: classify materiality before read; record reference factor where justified
actions.symbol_change: continue permanent identity with dated map
actions.merger_demerger: end or branch identity per official terms; no synthetic continuation without frozen mapping
actions.extraordinary_distribution: record and fail closed until adjustment treatment classified

corporate_actions.mixing: adjusted and raw OHLC may not be combined in one execution series
corporate_actions.failure: unresolved material action blocks affected identity/date and, if required coverage fails, dataset admission

calendar_manifest.source: authoritative evidence only; no weekday inference

bars.choice: acquire canonical five-minute candles and aggregate; do not mix native 30/60 candles
bars.OHLC: open first, high max, low min, close last
bars.boundaries: group only contiguous expected source bars within one session; never cross session
bars.incomplete: retain raw and quality record but exclude incomplete aggregate interval from research
bars.special_CAS: derive grids from authoritative per-date open/close and CAS policy; same full-source-bar rule

session_divisibility.terminal_policy: exclude residual from both research conditions; record as TERMINAL_PARTIAL in derived manifest; do not pad, extend, merge, or fabricate

series: selection-date sector index for every cohort identity
context_manifest.alignment: same calendar and aggregation grids as equities
context_manifest.missing: required context gap fails closed for affected date across aligned cohort

periods.anchor: T = latest completed authoritative normal session permitted by a separately authorized acquisition request
periods.boundaries: Let D0=T minus 24 calendar months, D1=T minus 12 months, D2=T minus 6 months. A starts first valid session on/after D0 and ends last valid session before D1; B starts first on/after D1 and ends last before D2; C starts first on/after D2 and ends T.
periods.selection_date: last valid session before Stage A start

identity_split.dependencies: identity and frozen protocol hash only

sample_sufficiency.chronological: three predetermined blocks, each >=60 trades and >=90% authoritative scheduled sessions admitted
sample_sufficiency.rationale: 120 observations per condition and 240 total provide minimally stable mean/tail diagnostics while 80% breadth prevents sparse-subset passage; day-block bootstrap still governs uncertainty

breadth_gate.participation: at least ceil(0.80*N) instruments with >=1 eligible trade
breadth_gate.median: median per-instrument gross expectancy in R >0, with zero-trade cohort members reported separately
breadth_gate.rationale: majority sign breadth plus median and concentration prevent a tiny winning subset

condition_gate.rule: both 30m and 60m pooled equal-instrument gross expectancy must be >0 and pooled co-primary metric >0; no winner selection

group_gate.visible: participation >=ceil(0.80*N_visible), equal-instrument gross expectancy >0, median participating instrument expectancy >0
group_gate.withheld: participation >=ceil(0.80*N_withheld), equal-instrument gross expectancy >0, median participating instrument expectancy >0

chronology.blocks: split ordered Stage B authoritative sessions into three contiguous blocks with counts differing by at most one; earlier blocks receive remainder sessions
chronology.gate: each >=60 trades; at least two of three gross-positive; no block contributes >60% of summed positive block gross P&L

friction.numerator: sum explicit charges plus absolute modeled adverse slippage cost across all Stage B trades
friction.denominator: sum over trades of max(pre-friction trade P&L,0), where pre-friction P&L adds modeled slippage back to gross P&L

concentration.contribution: for unit u, max(sum gross P&L after slippage before charges for u,0)
concentration.denominator: sum positive contributions at the same unit level
concentration.undefined: zero denominator is automatic failure; negative units contribute zero, never reduce denominator

pf_drawdown.evaluation: aggregate frozen portfolio equity only for gates
pf_drawdown.diagnostics: report per-condition and per-instrument PF/DD without extra pass/fail claims

primary_metric.trade_R: gross P&L after adverse slippage and before explicit charges divided by frozen initial monetary risk at entry
primary_metric.instrument_expectancy: arithmetic mean trade_R for that instrument and condition
primary_metric.condition_expectancy: arithmetic mean of participating instrument expectancies; zero-trade instruments excluded from numeric mean but retained as failures/coverage records
primary_metric.overall: arithmetic mean of 30m and 60m condition expectancies
primary_metric.absent_event: selected identity remains denominator for participation; valid post-selection unavailability is reported and never imputed

statistics.hierarchy: resample instruments with replacement within visible/withheld strata, then contiguous trading-day blocks with replacement within sampled instruments; keep all trades/events on sampled days
statistics.block_length: on Stage A only, choose smallest integer days at or above first lag where absolute autocorrelation of daily aggregate R is below 0.10 for two consecutive lags; clamp to [5,20]; freeze before B

acquisition_request.chunking: closed-open chunks aligned to authoritative session dates; deduplicate boundary timestamps and verify full requested coverage
acquisition_request.retry: bounded three attempts only for explicitly retryable transport failures; byte-identical successful response retained once
acquisition_request.rate_limit: provider-published limit with deterministic sequential pacing; no parallel burst

sealing: authorized acquisition writes immutable raw bytes and metadata
hash raw, derived, metadata, and manifests
permit Stage A read and mark first-read
on authorized open record first-read timestamp
bind held-out exposure to frozen strategy/spec hash
atomically change canonical-run count 0 to 1; reject further canonical runs

access_guard.layer: research data-governance layer; historical transport unchanged
access_guard.read_requirements: manifest role/state, explicit authorization artifact, matching phase22/phase23 and strategy/spec hashes, dataset hashes, run lock
access_guard.Stage_A: read permitted after validation and registration
access_guard.Stage_B_C: deny unless OPEN_AUTHORIZED and correct predecessor gates; first read atomically records exposure
access_guard.run_lock: compare-and-set canonical_run_count from 0 to 1; any later attempt denied

phase24_authorization.external_gate: separate explicit user authorization naming permitted sources, date scope, and network/data acquisition
phase24_authorization.recommended_scope: Implement synthetic-tested governance manifests/guards and, only under separate explicit authorization, acquire authoritative metadata first; do not acquire price candles or implement a strategy in the same step.
